violations.text: An employee was observed washing their hands at the 3-bay sink. Food employees shall clean their hands in a designated hand-washing sink and not in a food preparation, mop, or ware-washing sink. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Dish sponges were observed in the hand-washing sinks in the kitchen and the sushi bar. A hand-washing sink must not be used for purposes other than hand washing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Raw animal foods (chicken, fish) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (vegetables) in the walk-in refrigerator and prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

The quaternary ammonium concentration in the sanitizing solution of the 3-bay sink was 100 parts per million (ppm). According to the manufacturer's use directions, the concentration of the quaternary ammonium must be 200 ppm. PIC replaced container of sanitizer during inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Fish, chicken, and beef were observed held at 47-48 degrees Fahrenheit int he small prep unit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Foods that were brought from walk-in were moved to other refrigeration. Foods that had been in unit overnight were disposed. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Recently prepared sushi rolls were observed held at 47 degrees above the fill line in the large prep unit. Sushi rolls were placed in the low boy. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Multiple foods were observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Staff were unable to demonstrate proper calibration of pH meter and testing of sushi rice. Manager calibrated meter and completed pH measurement of rice. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026

Working containers of tea leaves and spices are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
Boxes of food were observed stored on the floor in the walk-in. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

Bowls are being used as scoops in containers of sauces. Utensils used to dispense non-time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods such as sugar and flour must be stored in the food item with their handles above the top of the food within the container. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
Spatulas were observed stored between prep unit and hand-washing sink in the kitchen. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
Boxes of single service items were observed stored on the floor in the storage area. PIC placed on shelving. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/20/2026
Inspector observed several single-use containers being re-used for other food items. PIC informed. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026

The small prep unit in the kitchen was observed in poor repair, with an ambient temperature of 49 degrees. PIC stated low boy in sushi bar was non-functional, replacement has been ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The non-food contact surfaces of the ice have an accumulation of debris. New Violation. Correct By: 08/03/2026
The walk-in freezer air curtain was observed in poor repair. PIC stated replacement has been ordered. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2026

Food contact surfaces of equipment/utensils (ice machine) were observed with an accumulation of biofilm debris. The food contact surfaces of equipment must be clean to sight and touch. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2026
The consumer advisory provided does not disclose the foods on the menu that are raw or undercooked. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2026

The following were observed in poor repair: -prep unit non-functional -low boy refrigerator not maintaining ambient temperature of 41 degrees or colder -prep unit lid -walk-in air curtain. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2026

Plywood is used in the construction of lower shelf of the prep table (near rice cookers); the finish on the lower shelving of the bar area has worn through. Non-food contact surfaces of equipment that are exposed to splash, spillage, or other food soiling or that require frequent cleaning must be constructed of a nonabsorbent and smooth material. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2026
The facility is lacking thermo labels or similar internal temperature indicating device for the dish machine. New Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2026

The prep sink is lacking an air gap; an air-break is present. A direct connection must not exist between the sewage system and a drain originating from equipment in which food is placed. New Violation. Correct By: 05/13/2026
The outside dumpster is not covered. Receptacles and waste handling units for refuse, recyclables, and returnables shall be kept covered. New Violation. Correct By: 04/29/2026
